chapter: Arriving in New York: the Nest Club and Harlem nightlife
title: Harry White's Nest Club band personnel
summary: Danny names Cripple Smitty, Glyn Paque who died in Switzerland, a linguist trumpeter, and Lloyd Phillips.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel

blocks.x: Do you remember any of the guys that was in that band?
It was probably Harry White's band.
Harry White's band. There was Cripple Smitty.
He played drums. There was Glen Pack, who played alto sax, who went to Europe...

He was disgusted in New York, he said, 'I'm going to Europe,' and he went to Europe. He never did come back. He died in Switzerland. The trumpet player was named Ted...Ted something. He had been with Leroy Smith's band. He was a legitimate trumpet player who played a little Jazz. But he was a linguist, spoke six or seven languages. He worked for the State Department. He was a very polished man, and I sat next to him... Glen Pack, him and Harry White was the three horns. Lloyd Phillips, who later played with...
Oh yeah. He last played with Pearl Bailey.
He was with Pearl Bailey for something like twenty years, until he died.
Mmm-hmm. He was on piano. I played the banjo, and Cripple Smitty was on drums.
